Central Park, Burnaby: 11 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 18%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 20 of 35 Burnaby communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Central Park fell from 12 in June to 11 in September, and 6 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 2.4% of Burnaby’s 458 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Central Park?
Central Park also had 22 condos and townhomes listed and 6 sold in September, against 11 houses listed. The Central Park condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Central Park?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 11 houses listed in Central Park. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Central Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Central Park had a sales ratio of 18%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Central Park from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses sold in Central Park over those 4 months, out of 199 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Central Park?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
